The Artist

Drawn by hand.
Felt by heart.

Every portrait begins with a blank sheet of premium paper and ends as something irreplaceable — a permanent record of someone's presence, drawn entirely by hand.

Ten Years of Craft

Ali Haider has spent over a decade refining the art of graphite and charcoal. What began as a quiet obsession became a lifelong discipline. Every portrait carries that accumulated knowledge.

3–4 Days of Focus

Each commission demands 3–4 full days of concentrated work. Not rushed. Not outsourced. The slow building of tone, the patient study of a face — this is craft in its truest sense.

The Medium

Graphite and charcoal are unforgiving materials. There is no undo. Each mark is a commitment. The resulting depth is something no digital process can replicate.

Any Subject, Any Style

Portraits, couples, families, celebrities, animals, scenes — Ali draws it all. The discipline is the same: total attention, total care, every time.
